result.stdout:
Description:
  epsitec-format — line-based source text checks and fixes.

Usage:
  epsitec-format [<targets>...] [options]

Arguments:
  <targets>  Files, directories, or glob patterns to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

Options:
  --fix                        Apply fixable rules in place. Absent means check mode (no writes).
  --rules <rules>              Comma-separated subset of comments,indent,initializers,encoding,razor,suppressions,header,comment-style,xmldoc,layout. Absent means all ten.
  --ids, --include-ids <ids>   Comma-separated FMT identifiers to check and fix (e.g. FMT0003). Absent means all.
  --exclude-ids <exclude-ids>  Comma-separated FMT identifiers to leave out of the run, applied after --ids (e.g. FMT0024,FMT0026).
  --extensions <extensions>    Comma-separated file extensions the encoding and layout rules check (e.g. .md,.txt), replacing their default list.
  --max-columns <max-columns>  Positive integer wrap width of comment prose. Absent means the epsitec_comment_line_length of .editorconfig, else 79.
  --json                       Emit the structured JSON report on stdout. Absent means a human-readable summary.
  --msbuild                    Emit one build-tool diagnostic line per issue on stdout (path(line,1): info|warning|error FMTnnnn: title).
  --summary                    Emit only the number of issues per FMT identifier and severity, without the file list.
  --changed <changed>          Check only the files listed in this file (one path per line), or on stdin with '-'. Replaces the targets. Also reports the diff-reach diagnostics.
  --update-year                Check the copyright year of the changed files against the current year, and bring it up to date with --fix (requires --changed).
  --year <year>                Year used by --update-year instead of the local clock (four digits).
  --fail-on <fail-on>          Which issues make the run exit 1: none, unfixable (report-only issues) or any. Absent means any in check mode and none in fix mode. An issue counts when its sev
